invariants.rationale: A well-designed method returning a collection should never return null, but rather an empty list to indicate no elements.
Each file ID generated via the mapping from smallFile.location.getFileId() should be non-null as file IDs are expected to exist.
The method is specified to return a List<String>, so at exit this must hold.
File IDs are typically non-empty strings; this suggests none of the smallFiles had missing/blank file IDs.
The mapping to file IDs suggests a one-to-one correspondence; this invariant would hold if all smallFiles have distinct file IDs.
